as_told.title: Legacy programs used nuclear material as bait for UFOs

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that older secret US government UFO programs used nuclear material, or sometimes fake nuclear material, as bait to make UFOs show up. He credits the claim to Garry Nolan, a Stanford microbiologist, and in that version it also covers Russia, from the middle of the last century into the 1990s. If true, it would mean these objects are drawn to nuclear material and that governments have known this and used it on purpose.
